subject: Demo: Redwood Inference for Acme — timing & procurement
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@acme.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:15:00-05:00
Subject: Demo: Redwood Inference — proposed times this week

Hi Sam —

Thanks for the inbound interest — excited to show you Redwood Inference and walk through how our serving/runtime can help reduce per-token cost and stabilize latency for your LLM features.

I pulled together a couple 60-min slots this week when Aditya (solutions) and I are both available:
- Wed 11/20 3:30-4:30pm ET
- Thu 11/21 10:00-11:00am ET

If neither works, we can look at early December; curious whether you want an exec-level 30m first and a deeper demo later.

Attached a short deck to give context.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood-quick-demo.pdf]

From: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T15:40:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Demo: Redwood Inference — proposed times this week

Marissa —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. We're actually in the middle of a pretty locked down budget/approval window: our FY spend freeze starts 11/29 and procurement is tied up with quarter-end audits and a couple of leadership off-sites (travel). That makes the next two weeks harder for scheduling deeper technical demos.

Could we look at the first full week of December instead? After 12/5 should be fine — procurement can confirm once we know the target timing. If it helps, we'd be open to a short 20-30m exec call now to keep momentum.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Taylor
Director, Product — Acme Corp

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T10:05:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Demo: Redwood Inference — proposed times this week

Looping in Rachel (account lead) to keep her in the loop. Good call from Sam — budget freezes + travel are a common slip.

Marissa — two pragmatic options:
1) Offer a brief 30m exec touchpoint this week to align on outcomes and procurement ask; schedule the deep technical demo for after 12/5.
2) If procurement prefers, target the first full week of Dec (12/6-12/10) and share a mutual action plan so they can align internal stakeholders.

Aditya, if you can draft a 1-page mutual action plan (owners, milestones, procurement items) I'll review and Rachel can share it with Acme.


— Laura
VP, North America Sales

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T08:30:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Demo: Redwood Inference — proposed times this week

Sam —

Totally understand — thanks for the context. Two quick asks/suggestions so we can keep things moving:

1) Would you prefer a short 30m executive alignment now (we'll keep it high level, execs only) and then the 60m technical demo after your budget reopens?
2) If procurement would rather schedule everything after the freeze, we can propose these windows:
   - Mon 12/6 afternoon ET
   - Tue 12/7 10:00-11:00am ET
   - Tue 12/14 2:00-3:00pm ET

Aditya attached a quick mutual action plan template — filling owners/dates will help get procurement comfortable.

[attachment: mutual_action_plan.xlsx]

Happy to do whichever works best for you.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@acme.com>
Cc: Jamie Keller <jamie.keller@acme.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Demo: Redwood Inference — proposed times this week

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for following up. Our budget cycle closes 12/01 and many approvers are OOO during the last week of November for travel. We would prefer the substantive technical demo after 12/05 so we have visibility into budget reset numbers.

That said, we can do a short alignment call to review use cases and procurement asks. If you want to propose exact times, Jamie and I will confirm availability.

Proposed: Tue 12/7 10:00-11:00am ET — please send a calendar invite.

Procurement Team
Acme Corp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>, Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T11:00:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Demo: Redwood Inference — proposed times this week

Perfect — thanks for confirming. I've booked Tue 12/7 10:00-11:00am ET and sent a calendar invite (link here: https://cal.example.com/invite/abc123).

Next steps before the call:
- Aditya will share a 1-page mutual action plan (owners + milestones).
- Rachel will include procurement/redlines checklist and our standard timeline for Dedicated/private deployments.

If anything changes on your side, let me know — otherwise we'll plan for the Dec 7 slot and save the deep technical walkthrough for the week of 12/13 when budgets are finalized.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
